technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, Supertrend, Hull) show bullish bias, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200), Ichimoku cloud, and lacks trend strength (ADX 20.98); weak volume confirmation and overbought oscillators suggest limited upside probability.

fundamental.summary: FOX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 40 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (25/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral to weak bullish setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (360.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, with earnings binary event in 40 days adding execution risk.
